title: GNSS interference monitor from u-blox telemetry and ADS-B NACp
summary: A stdlib heuristic scorer turns per-epoch receiver telemetry (C/N0 across SVs, AGC, CW jamming indicator, clock, position and velocity, receiver spoofing/jamming flags, and the navigation data the receiver decoded) into jamming and spoofing scores. Instantaneous rules are joined by power CUSUMs on the median per-SV C/N0 deviation and on AGC that catch staircase power changes, by position consistency against the best reference available (IMU/odometry/static velocity, else the receiver's own reported velocity integrated over a 10 s window so normal driving stays consistent, else a constant-velocity prior), Doppler velocity and clock-rate CUSUMs, a velocity-jump bound, and lost fix as its own alert class. Each reference learns only while its own detector is quiet; the per-SV C/N0 baseline is robust (clipped innovations), keeps learning through spoofing sub-alerts so a recovered sky is re-learned, and can drift at a bounded rate while frozen. An ephemeris module decodes GPS LNAV subframes from UBX-RXM-SFRBX and flags SVs whose decoded orbit/clock disagrees with an independent IGS broadcast file. Alerts latch until explicit clear conditions hold and every alert carries value, threshold, unit and evidence. A pyubx2 adapter feeds it from UBX NAV-PVT/SAT/STATUS/CLOCK, MON-RF and SEC-SIG; eval_real.py scores it per slot and detector on the real Jammertest 2024 VAARA logs with a tune/holdout split. A second module applies the GPSJam percentage method to readsb aircraft.json NACp for area-level maps.
verified: Ran 2026-11-06. Tests: 53 (30 scorer, 12 real-data defect regressions, 6 ephemeris, 6 area map, 1 UBX replay) OK on /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 3.14.7 without packages (1 skipped: pyubx2) and OK with pyubx2 1.4.1 on Python 3.13.15. The defect regressions fail on the previous scorer (git dae8229) for driving, position pull, velocity jump, step drop after recovery, C/N0 and AGC staircase and spoofed ephemeris. Mutation check: 10 of 12 single mutations of the new logic fail 1-3 tests; references frozen by any alarm and the power term of the clear rule are not covered. Real data: eval_real.py on the 7 VAARA u-blox logs (13 h, 20 attack slots + 1 quiet), 4 parameters chosen on 3 tuning logs, reported on all 7 with a 4-log holdout: the quiet slot went from 98 % alerting (constant-velocity pos_drift) to 0 %, pos_drift false-alert epochs 10220 => 275, driving alarm time 86 % => 28 %, and every attack slot is detected by a C/N0 detector (before, without the latched pos_drift, 4 slots incl. the 2.4.3 staircase were missed). The ephemeris check, against IGS BRDC from the BKG mirror, decoded 267 GPS sets with 0 parity failures and flagged spoofer ephemerides (276 km to 53 000 km off) in 7 of the 8 spoofing slots, never on the jamming-only days. Synthetic: 20 h soak per reference mode 0 / 0 / 17 alert epochs (cv-prior / doppler / external static); a drag that moves position and Doppler together is not detected without an external reference (by design, drag table in README). gnss-signal-chain GNSS-SDR epochs rescored: clean 0 alerts, overpower/jam-then-spoof alert at attack onset (power CUSUM), drag-off alerts at +6 s on its power step but pos_drift only with --ref-vel 0,0. Not verified: live u-blox receiver, AGC/MON-RF on real data (VAARA has none), Galileo/GLONASS/BeiDou ephemeris checking, real readsb feed, any OSNMA processing.
shows: Per-receiver scorer for jamming, spoofing (incl. staircase power and spoofer ephemerides), clock drift and lost fix from u-blox telemetry, evaluated on real Jammertest 2024 logs; ADS-B NACp area map
runtime: tests under 1 s; real-data evaluation ~11 s per run (after a 64 MB download)
key_result: [Jammertest 2024 holdout](README.md#real-data-evaluation-jammertest-2024): quiet slot 98 % => 0 % alerting, pos_drift false-alert epochs 10220 => 275, 20 / 20 attack slots by C/N0 detectors (2.4.3 staircase at +8 s), spoofer ephemerides flagged in 7 of 8 spoofing slots vs IGS BRDC; coherent drag needs an external reference
